text: So sorry to trouble you this late. My grandson is 2 and his temperature is 39.9. He's very dark skinned so I couldn't see much on his body, but I looked at the palms of his hands, the soles of his feet and inside his bottom eyelids, and there are tiny dark red dots there. I pressed a glass on his palm and they didn't go away. I'm probably fussing but his mum's working nights and I didn't know who else to ask.
